description: Land Title Settlement Department - Abagahawewa (Block 01), Nochchiyagama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110279
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act.
